title: Decimals as fractions with powers-of-ten denominators
subtitle: Connect tenths, hundredths, and thousandths to base-ten place value.
challenge: A runner's split time is recorded as 14.35 seconds. What exact rational fraction of a second does the 0.35 portion represent?
predictionPrompt: Which rational fraction is exactly equivalent to the decimal 0.35?
formalDefinition: A finite decimal 0.d_1 d_2 ... d_k represents the exact rational number d_1/10 + d_2/100 + ... + d_k/10^k = (d_1 d_2 ... d_k) / 10^k. Each position to the right of the decimal point divides the unit value by ten.

steps: Identify the place value of the final digit: in 0.35, '3' is in the tenths place (3/10) and '5' is in the hundredths place (5/100).
Combine into a single fraction over the common denominator 100: 30/100 + 5/100 = 35/100.
Simplify to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by gcd(35, 100) = 5: (35 ÷ 5) / (100 ÷ 5) = 7/20.

misconception.mistake: Believing 0.35 is greater than 0.7 because 35 is a larger whole number than 7.
misconception.correction: Compare by place value from left to right: 0.7 = 7 tenths = 70 hundredths (70/100), whereas 0.35 = 3 tenths and 5 hundredths (35/100). 70/100 is twice as large as 35/100.

reflection: A decimal is just place value continued to the right of the units place using negative powers of ten (1/10, 1/100, 1/1000). To convert any fraction to a terminating decimal, find an equivalent fraction whose denominator is a power of 10.
prerequisiteCheck: Explain why 1/10 is ten times smaller than 1, and 1/100 is ten times smaller than 1/10.
representation: Imagine a 10×10 grid of 100 small squares representing 1 whole. 1 column of 10 squares is 1 tenth (0.1 = 10/100). 3 full columns plus 5 small squares equal 35 hundredths (0.35 = 35/100).

faded.prompt: Convert 3/4 to a decimal: Multiply numerator and denominator by 25 to make the denominator 100: (3 × 25) / (4 × 25) = __ / 100 = __.

independent.prompt: Convert 0.6 to a canonical fraction in lowest terms.

explanation: Why do only fractions whose simplified denominator contains no prime factors other than 2 and 5 yield terminating decimals in base ten?

transfer.prompt: A digital scale shows 0.125 kg. Express this reading as an exact simplified fraction of a kilogram.
transfer.solution: 0.125 = 125/1000. Dividing both by gcd(125, 1000) = 125 gives 1/8 kg.

retrieval: Tomorrow, without consulting notes, convert 0.45 into a simplified fraction and 7/25 into a decimal.
